identificationModule.officialTitle: A Study of GC022F CAR-T Cell Immunotherapy for Relapsed or Refractory B- ALL

primaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and severity of treatment related Adverse Events, CRS and Neurotoxicity (Safety and tolerability)
primaryOutcomes.description: Adverse events(AEs) will be collected and graded according to ASTCT consensus(for Cytokine Release Syndrome, CRS and Immune Effector Cell-Associated Neurotoxicity Syndrome, ICANS) and CTCAE v5.0(for AE except CRS/ICANS )

secondaryOutcomes.measure: CAR copies and concentration of GC022F in peripheral blood, bone marrow and CSF (amplification and persistence)
secondaryOutcomes.description: GC022F CAR copies and cells in peripheral blood, bone marrow and CSF will be measured by qPCR and FCM in 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Overall response rate of patients who received GC022F infusion (efficacy)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Overall response rate will be estimated as the percents of patients who achieved CR or CRi.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Concentraiton of anti-GC022F antibody after infusion (humoral immune response)
secondaryOutcomes.description: After GC022F infusion, GC022F antibody in peripheral blood will be measured in 2 years
